description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class `Endpoint` in the namespace `OrangeHRM\Core\Api\V2`. It provides common functionality for API endpoints, such as managing request parameters, validation, sorting, and pagination. The class uses traits and interacts with other classes like `Request`, `RequestParams`, and `ValidationDecorator` to facilitate API request handling within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: Endpoint
classes.description: An abstract class providing foundational functionality for API endpoints, including request handling, sorting, pagination, and validation setup.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the endpoint with the provided request, setting up request parameters and calling an optional initialization method.

methods.name: init
methods.description: A protected method intended to be overridden by subclasses for additional initialization.

methods.name: getRequestParams
methods.description: Returns the current request parameters object.

methods.name: getValidationDecorator
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the validation decorator instance.

methods.name: setSortingAndPaginationParams
methods.description: Configures filtering, sorting, and pagination parameters based on request query parameters, with an optional default sort field.

methods.name: getSortingAndPaginationParamsRules
methods.description: Returns validation rules for sorting and pagination query parameters, with options to specify allowed sort fields and whether to exclude sort field validation.

methods.name: getAttributeId
methods.description: Retrieves the 'id' attribute parameter from the request, expected as an integer.
